principle: Citizenship, legal status, organization membership, assignment, allegiance, sympathy and cultural identity are distinct character state.
rules: Species does not grant faction membership.
Birthplace does not automatically settle citizenship unless applicable law says so.
Organization membership does not prove personal agreement with every policy.
Assignment is not the same as membership.
Leaving an organization ends or changes current membership state but preserves history.
Covert, disputed or unknown affiliation may exist with restricted knowledge visibility.
AI cannot infer secret membership or loyalty from species, culture, uniform appearance or reputation alone.
